ch1-logging-in.en: Welcome! Let's start with the very first step: logging in to your school account.
Open the application in your browser, and type your username into the login page.
Now press Sign In, and you'll land right on your dashboard.
That's it. You're logged in and ready to go.
ch2-school-setup-wizard.en: The school setup wizard guides you through everything, one step at a time.
Open School Setup from the sidebar.
It walks you through setup in order, from the school profile to the final review.
Finish a step, then press Next Step to move on.
Not ready yet? Press Skip, and leave that step for later.
You can press Exit Setup at any time, and come back whenever you like.
Set up step by step, at your own pace.
ch2-step-1-academic-year-terms.en: Every school year begins here: let's create your academic year and its terms.
Open Management, then choose Sessions from the menu.
On the Academic Years tab, press Add Academic Year.
Enter a name for the year, along with its start date and end date, then press Save.
Press Set Current to make it the active year, which the whole system will follow.
Now open the Terms tab, and press Add Term.
Enter the term name, its type, the dates and the order. Then repeat this for every term in the year.
ch2-step-2-create-classes.en: Next, let's create your classes and sections.
Switch to the Master view and press Class. Choose the grade level, confirm the name, and save without any sections.
Repeat for each grade. Master classes are shared across every academic year.
Now switch to Session Classes for the active year, and create sections such as A and B.
ch2-step-3-add-students.en: Choose the class and enter the student's name. The roll number is suggested for you. Then add the parent's name and phone number.
Save, and the student appears in the list.
Use the class filter to view one class. Big lists can be imported from Excel.
ch2-step-4-add-subjects.en: Now let's add the subjects your school teaches.
In the Subjects tab, press Add Subject.
Type the subject name. The code is filled in for you, and you can edit it if you like.
Press Create, and the subject appears in the list.
To use the subject in a class, open the class assignments tab.
ch2-step-5-create-timetable.en: Let's build a timetable for a class.
Select the class whose timetable you want to create.
Rows are the time slots. Click a cell, choose the subject for that period, and press Set. The teacher assigned to the subject is filled in automatically.
Press Save Timetable. Students and parents can see it right away.
ch3-viewing-the-attendance-register.en: Let's see how to read the attendance register.
Open Attendance, then choose Attendance Record.
Select a class to see its register.
Use the month arrows to move between months.
Students are listed in rows and days run across in columns. Each cell shows that day's mark.
To keep a copy, press the download button to save the register as a PDF.
ch5-academic-calendar.en: Keep everyone informed with the academic calendar.
Open Management, then choose Academic Calendar.
Use the month selectors to move around. Sundays are marked off automatically.
Press Add Event or Off Day.
Enter a title, choose OFF Day, pick a category, and set the start and end dates.
Press Save, and the off day appears on the calendar.
Your calendar is up to date.
ch5-student-promotion.en: At the end of the year, here's how to promote your students.
Select the year you're promoting from, and the year you're promoting to. Then press Next.
Choose the class to promote, and press Next.
This is the highest class, so students default to Graduate. Change each action to Promote, then choose the target class for everyone.
Press Promote Students. The result tells you how many were promoted.
